tasks.short: Meet investors to determine goals and discuss strategies

steps.what: Open the meeting and the investor's stated goals
Meet investors to determine their investment goals
Discuss investment strategies and write what was said

tasks.design: The meeting is on {CALENDAR}. Any goal already stated is opened from {CRM} as the investor's words, not as a score. The manager meets the investor, determines the goals in the conversation, and discusses strategies. The note is what was said. No investor is ranked.
tasks.previous_blocker: The last conversation was in a notebook, so the next meeting started cold.
tasks.enabler_now: A goal the investor already stated can be opened, so the meeting does not restart from nothing.
tasks.still_hard: Determining what the investor wants, and which strategy fits, stay a conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager determines the goals with the investor.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the last stated goals before the meeting, and nobody is scored.

evidence.claim: A prior statement can be opened, and the meeting stays with the manager and the investor. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an investor meeting is booked and ends when the manager has written what was determined.
A goal row has investor id and the words they stated, written by the manager after a meeting. An empty row is not filled with a guessed goal.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the investor wants the note shared back.
research_questions: Which meetings have no goal written yet?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a goal that was already written. The meeting and the determination stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend briefings and consult financial media on markets

steps.what: List investment briefings and financial media items
Attend briefings and consult the financial media
Note relevant markets the reading did not cover

tasks.design: Briefing titles and media items are listed in {DOCS} and {CALENDAR}. The manager attends and consults them to stay abreast of relevant markets. A title is not treated as a conclusion. The note stores the market point the manager wrote.
tasks.previous_blocker: Briefings were forwarded mail, and a missed one showed up only when a market had moved.
tasks.enabler_now: The list shows what is on, so the manager spends the time in the briefing rather than finding it.
tasks.still_hard: What a briefing means for this fund stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which market point matters.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the week's briefings before attending.

reach.learn: Which market the note is about.

evidence.claim: A list of briefings can be opened, and attending and reading stay with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a briefing or a media item is listed and ends when the manager has noted what was relevant.
A row has item id, title, and date, produced by the calendar or the feed. A title with no item id is read without being stored as a fact.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the feed includes the markets this fund actually holds.
research_questions: Which listed briefings were not attended?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is collecting titles that are already listed. Attending, consulting the media, and the judgement stay with the manager.

tasks.short: Prepare for and respond to regulatory inquiries

steps.what: Open the regulatory inquiry and its questions
Prepare a pack from the stored records

loop.purpose: Assemble a response pack only from stored records named on the inquiry.
loop.input: Inquiry id and the stored record ids.
loop.output: A pack of those records, or a stop.
loop.check: Every record in the pack is a stored id the inquiry named.
loop.stop: Stop when a named record id is missing.
loop.why_not_simpler: A response that invents a record cannot be sent to an authority.

steps.what: Respond to the inquiry from the prepared pack
Send the regulatory response the manager signed

tasks.design: The inquiry is opened from {GOV_PORTAL}. A pack is prepared in {DOCS} only from records the inquiry names that are already stored. The manager writes the response and signs it before it is sent. A missing record stops the pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: The response was hunted from mail and old filings the week the inquiry arrived.
tasks.enabler_now: Named records can be assembled by id, so the gap is visible before the reply is written.
tasks.still_hard: How to answer, and whether a record really responds to the question, stay with the manager.

ambition.what: A complete set of named records is packed the day the inquiry arrives, and the manager still signs the reply.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees which questions have a record and which do not.

evidence.claim: An inquiry pack contains stored records, and the manager signs the response. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a regulatory inquiry arrives and ends when the manager has signed the response.
A record has record id and body, already filed. An inquiry question with no record id is answered by the manager without a packed record.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the authority asks for something that was never filed.
research_questions: Which questions stopped because the record was missing?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: response the manager signed for that inquiry

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts questions whose records are already stored. A gap is filled by the manager, and the signature stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate new product developments and market opportunities

steps.what: Open the product plan and the stored factors
Evaluate market opportunities against those factors
Note potential the business plans did not cover

tasks.design: The business plan and the factors the manager listed, including technologies already named, are opened from {DOCS}. The manager evaluates the market opportunity and the potential. A factor that is not stored is not treated as met. The system does not score the opportunity.
tasks.previous_blocker: The evaluation was a fresh note, and the plan's factors were checked afterwards if at all.
tasks.enabler_now: The factors are on the opportunity, so the evaluation starts from a list rather than from memory.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the potential is worth pursuing stays the manager's judgement.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the stored factors before judging the opportunity.

evidence.claim: A factor list can be opened, and the evaluation stays with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a new product or market is proposed and ends when the manager has written the evaluation.
A factor has opportunity id and text, written by the manager from the plan. An opportunity with no factors is evaluated without a checklist.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the plan's technologies are described well enough to check.
research_questions: Which opportunities have no stored factors?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening factors that are already written. The evaluation of potential stays with the manager.
